registry:

    title: "2.3.10.7 | Ensure 'Network access: Remotely accessible registry paths' is configured | Machine"
    exists: true
    value: "System\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\ProductOptions\nSystem\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Server Applications\nSoftware\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion"
    type: REG_MULTI_SZ
    meta:
      workstation: 1
      CIS_ID:

      NIST800-53R5:
        - AC-6(7)(b)
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

    - rule_2.3.10.7
